title: Fix badge visibility at top and bottom

requirements.summary: Resize the SSL Protected badge container at the top of the page to display the full badge without cutoff
acceptanceCriteria: SSL Protected badge at top is fully visible without any portion being cut off
Badge container height accommodates the complete badge image
Badge maintains proper aspect ratio and image quality

file_operations.description: Increase the height of the SSL Protected badge container in the top trust badges section to prevent cutoff. The badge image at frontend/public/assets/generated/badge-ssl.dim_200x80.png requires adequate vertical space. Adjust container styling to use explicit height values (e.g., h-20 or h-24 instead of h-16) and ensure the image maintains its aspect ratio without cropping.

requirements.summary: Resize the Quality/Verified badge container at the top of the page to display the full badge without cutoff
acceptanceCriteria: Quality badge at top is fully visible without any portion being cut off
Badge container height accommodates the complete badge image
Badge maintains proper alignment with other top badges

file_operations.description: Increase the height of the Amazon Verified badge container in the top trust badges section to prevent cutoff. The badge image at frontend/public/assets/generated/badge-amazon-verified.dim_200x80.png requires adequate vertical space. Adjust container styling to match the SSL badge height fix and ensure consistent alignment across all three top badges (SSL, Verified, Fast Delivery).

requirements.summary: Resize all badge containers at the bottom of the page (footer area) to display badges with full visibility
acceptanceCriteria: All footer badges are fully visible without cutoff
Badge containers properly sized to show complete badge images
Badges maintain consistent spacing and alignment in footer

file_operations.description: Increase the height of all footer badge containers (SSL, Amazon Verified, Genuine, Return Guarantee, Secure Checkout, Discount) to prevent cutoff. The badge images at frontend/public/assets/generated/badge-*.dim_200x80.png require adequate vertical space. Adjust the TrustBadges component props or wrapper styling to use larger height values (e.g., h-20 or h-24) and ensure all badges render with proper spacing and alignment in the footer section.

Adjust the badge image container styling to prevent cutoff when rendering badges. Update the wrapper div or image element classes to use explicit height values that accommodate the full badge dimensions (200x80px). Ensure the component properly handles both horizontal (footer) and vertical layouts while maintaining aspect ratios and preventing overflow clipping.
